original_ai_output.title_zh: 刚果（金）本迪布焦型埃博拉疫情扩散至第七个省，逼近中非共和国边境
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 世界卫生组织非洲区域办事处通报，刚果（金）本迪布焦型埃博拉病毒病疫情已扩散至第七个省，苏德乌班吉省布卢卫生区报告首例确诊病例，该省与中非共和国和刚果（布）接壤。截至2026年9月13日，累计确诊病例7258例，其中死亡3510例，病死率48.4%。自上一期周报以来新增572例确诊病例和284例死亡病例。

location.raw_text: Bulu Health Zone, Sud-Ubangi, a province bordering the Central African Republic and the Republic of the Congo

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）本迪布焦型埃博拉疫情扩散至第七个省，苏德乌班吉省布卢卫生区报告首例确诊病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has expanded to a seventh province, with the first confirmed case reported in Bulu Health Zone, Sud-Ubangi

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Since External Situation Report #17, a further 572 confirmed cases and 284l confirmed deaths have been reported

key_facts.fact: 疫情已波及七个省的62个卫生区
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The outbreak now affects 62 health zones across seven provinces
